topics.topic: How TrialExecution records the requesting agent and distinguishes explicit tries from automatic admission
questions: How does a TrialExecution identify the agent who requested that trial when that agent differs from the agent who submitted the implementation, and distinguish such a trial from executions created by automatic admission?
How does a TrialExecution produced by an explicit try action record which agent requested that try, especially when that agent did not submit the implementation?

quotes:
The owner's actions,
each agent's and the kernel's own are distinguishable in every record.

A record with
no by-field (AdmissionVerdict, TrialExecution, NodeExecution, EffectAttempt
apart from its `resolved_by`, an EffectApproval until decided, StoredValue,
SpooledFile) names no actor: it is the kernel's work, and the request that
caused it is told by the record it hangs from — the run's `started_by` and
resumptions, the approval's `decided_by`, the implementation's
`submitted_by`. No actor is inferred from an effect's authority.
judgement.why: One passage requires every agent's actions to be distinguishable in every record, while the other says TrialExecution names no actor and attributes its causing request through the implementation submitter.

topics.topic: Whether ProofResult identity includes proof-time dependency, binding, manifest, or result facts
questions: Is a ProofResult identified only by flow_version_id, or is each result a snapshot that also depends on the binding and manifest facts at proof time?
Is a ProofResult identified by the flow version alone, or by the flow version together with the dependency state or resulting proof facts at the time of proof?

quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
judgement.why: The ProofResult identity passage was unchanged by the reopening change, and none of the changed passages makes its dependency-state question newly material.

topics.topic: Scope of function inspection and how repair inspection is distinguished from composition inspection
questions: Which function records and implementation bodies may the general inspect action return, and what product action or request fact distinguishes repair inspection from composition inspection?

topics.topic: Startup lifecycle transitions for runs and node attempts left unfinished by a process stop
questions: What lifecycle transitions occur at startup for runs and node attempts that were unfinished when the process stopped?

topics.topic: Treatment and mutability of in-flight executions and effects after a run becomes final
questions: When cancellation or an owner's refusal makes a run final, what happens to already-sent effects and other executions that have not concluded, and may their records change after the run became final?

topics.topic: Whether AdmissionVerdict must name the kernel as deciding actor
questions: Does every AdmissionVerdict record the kernel as its deciding actor, or is admission exempt from the requirement that automatic decisions name the kernel?

topics.topic: Whether NodeExecution identity is value-based or keyed by its unique execution coordinates
questions: Is NodeExecution a value identified by all its facts, or an entity representing the uniquely issued observation at run_id, node_id, map_index and attempt_number?

topics.topic: Whether and how failed executions can be captured after run termination and spool cleanup
questions: Can a failed function execution be captured after its run ended refused or cancelled, and how is capture handled when that execution used files whose spool has already been emptied?

topics.topic: Whether cyclic submitted graphs are persisted as unproven FlowVersions or refused before creation
questions: When a submitted graph is cyclic, is it retained as an unproven FlowVersion, or refused before a FlowVersion exists?

topics.topic: Whether guarded skips permit run success and what counts as successful conclusion
questions: Can a run whose valid guard outcome skips nodes or flow outputs end succeeded, and what counts as a successfully concluded node or output for that rule?

topics.topic: Which digest inputs use JCS model encoding versus raw values or file bytes
questions: Which digests use JCS-encoded model facts, and which digest the underlying value or file bytes directly?
